description: Angular component for a user filter dialog in the Thingsboard UI, managing form controls, unit conversions, and filter data.

classes.name: UserFilterDialogComponent
classes.description: Angular component class for user filter dialog, handling form creation, validation, and data binding.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the component, sets up form controls based on filter data.

methods.name: createUserInputFormControl
methods.description: Creates a form group for a user input, handling unit conversion and value change subscriptions.

methods.name: userInputsFormArray
methods.description: Returns the FormArray of user inputs.

methods.name: isErrorState
methods.description: Determines if a form control is in an error state for UI validation.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Marks form as submitted and closes dialog with filter data.
